decisions.reason: As a multi-model flagship line tied to the firm's publicly announced move toward broader lower-carbon building-climate solutions, the accumulated investment, visibility and ability to frame any slower uptake as a temporary market-ramp issue make continued commitment most likely.

This hydrogen-capable flagship series is even more central to the firm's stated future and already publicly validated by a named real-site launch, so escalation of commitment strongly favors retaining it and attributing any remaining weakness to early-stage adoption rather than product failure.
